source_request: Photograph a sliced country loaf on a kitchen board for a small bakery’s weekend post, with the freshly cut face easy to see. Keep the scene about the bread and the kitchen objects.
interpreted_intent: Requester-owned: Sliced country loaf; Kitchen board; Freshly cut face visible; Small bakery weekend-post purpose; Bread and kitchen objects remain the focus. Authorial choices within open dimensions: Wooden material of board; Pale counter; Loose placement of slices; Window illumination; View showing exterior and cut face together. A very close cut-face study and a small kitchen preparation scene were considered; the preparation scene better supports the bakery's welcoming weekend use while retaining the requested cut face.
subject: sliced country loaf on kitchen board
setting: wooden kitchen board on a pale kitchen counter

baseline_prompt_en: A sliced country loaf rests on a kitchen board, its freshly cut face clearly visible beside the remaining bread. The slices sit loosely together as if cutting has just finished. The wooden board lies on a pale kitchen counter, with the bread taking most of the attention. This is a friendly bakery photograph for a weekend post, grounded in the everyday work of preparing bread to share. A nearby window lights the loaf, and the camera sees both the cut face and the loaf's outer shape.
